newsitem.title: UK: English China sees return to profit in H1 97.
newsitem.headline: English China sees return to profit in H1 97.

text.p: Specialty chemicals and minerals group English China Clays Plc said on Monday it expected to return to profitability in the first half of 1997.

In a telephone interview with Reuters, chief executive Dennis Rediker said most of the charges for the group's restructuring, which will include around 400 job losses worldwide, had been taken against 1996 results.

"Most of the cash costs for restructuring were taken in 1996 and I think most will be spent in 1997," said Rediker, who noted that the company posted a trading profit of 65.6 million stg last year before exceptional charges of 95.0 million stg.
Rediker said that the best way to reassure shareholders would be by "announcing improved results in the first half."
